title: Mermaid Roshan: Here I Am!
scope: 32 actual book pages; bounded detective preparation and light-reflection test before the existing under-pool voice adventure; unique native page pictures; story first; no game changes.

art_policy.source_images_role: identity and setting reference only, never repeated delivery frames
art_policy.pdf_placement: Whole native page at its native aspect, lossless embedding; physical PDF display size is declared separately.

lyrics: Hold a beat. Leave a space.
Help each friend to find their place.
Near or far, big or small,
We make room for us all!

pages.title: Mermaid Roshan: Here I Am!
pages.consequence: The cover promises Roshan taking her place in an ensemble, rather than a weapon quest.

panels.stage: Original portrait cover: smallest Roshan in foreground lifting one hand and smiling with anticipation, the three taller mermaid friends and Duri behind; Korean-inspired hanok rooftops, pearl bridge and shell concert stage under the clearly visible circular castle pool roof. No collage, weapon or duplicated character.

entries.speaker: Title
entries.text: Mermaid Roshan: Here I Am!

entries.speaker: Subtitle
entries.text: An adventure beneath Rumi's pool

pages.title: A turn, and a little glint
pages.consequence: Roshan states her singing wish before any heroic task. Rumi promises a turn and accepts a wobbling voice. A glint prompts deliberate detective preparation without revealing the missing candle.

panels.stage: Large first panel in the opening tier: castle pool room with the existing seahorse fountain and turning rainbow. Roshan faces Rumi hopefully at the water ledge. No rainbow candle, wax, flame or candle silhouette anywhere in the room. Keep both opening lines spacious and readable.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The castle candle was still missing. But tonight, a song was waiting beneath Rumi's pool.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I want to sing the first line. All by myself.

panels.stage: Large second panel: Rumi lowers to Roshan's eye level and offers an open hand; Roshan touches her own throat. Three spacious balloons read Rumi, then Roshan, then Rumi. The following four preparation panels are smaller, varied tiers, with every moment distinct. Preserve current cast identity, ordinary coral/cream pop-star coat and one tail each.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Then let's make that your turn.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: What if my voice wobbles?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: It can wobble. It's still yours. I'll be beside you, if you want.

panels.stage: Roshan points to a small patch of rainbow colour on bare stone UNDER the pool-room bench. Rumi follows her gaze. The patch is reflected light only, with no shaped object or flame inside it; quiet bench region makes the glint clear.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Is that a rainbow under the bench?

panels.stage: Roshan reaches into the familiar castle wardrobe and takes the established plum/brown deerstalker detective hat with gold edging and shell medallions in her hand. Show complete retrieval from shelf before the hat is worn. Hat/lens reference is prop-only; keep her current face, short wavy brown hair, rainbow forelock, coral/cream costume and single rainbow tail.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: My detective hat!

panels.stage: Roshan places the same hat on her head; its brim tips slightly too low. Her eyes, face and rainbow forelock remain identifiable. This is the placing action, distinct from retrieval and later settled fit. Rumi waits.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Too low.

panels.stage: With both hands Roshan adjusts the same hat brim above her eyes and settles its fit. Clear visible outcome of the preceding placing action; no extra arms or outfit replacement. Rumi watches without taking over.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Now I can see.

pages.title: Looking before guessing
pages.consequence: Roshan asks for an observation and tests a guess. Shading and unshading demonstrate reflected rainbow light rather than a recovered candle. Both detective tools are stowed before the underwater adventure.

panels.stage: Wearing the correctly settled hat, Roshan takes the familiar gold-rimmed round hand magnifier from the same open wardrobe. One hand grips its teal handle with gold shell details; preserve current ordinary outfit, hair/forelock and single tail. Only the hat and lens come from the detective card.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I'll look before I guess.

panels.stage: Roshan swims or leans low beside the bench, lens between one eye and the coloured patch. The magnified region contains bare stone and colour only, never wax, hidden object or a candle. Establish the existing turning rainbow and its reflected light path toward this bench.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Could our candle be here?

panels.stage: Roshan turns to ask Rumi directly. Rumi moves beside the patch with an unobstructed view so she can watch the light rather than supplying the answer. Distinct observation positions and correct speaker tails.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can you watch the glint?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Yes.

panels.stage: Roshan places her free palm across the reflected light path from the existing turning rainbow. A soft shadow interrupts the coloured patch on stone as the rainbow keeps turning. Rumi watches its movement and fading. Lens stays in Roshan's other hand. No beam emitted by Roshan, new magic or candle.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: It's moving with the rainbow.

panels.stage: Roshan lifts her palm out of the same light path; colour returns to the same bare stone. Clearly different shade/unshade states, with lens, hand and patch readable. She reports a local result rather than locating or denying the candle elsewhere.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: It's light. There's no candle under here.

panels.stage: Roshan returns BOTH the hat and the magnifier to the same wardrobe, hands placing tools on their shelf before diving. Her ordinary rainbow forelock is fully visible again. Rumi waits beside the pool. No detective hat or lens carried into page 4.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Ready for Song Night?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Yes. And I still want my first line.

pages.title: The neighbourhood and the warning
pages.consequence: One connected arrival establishes city life, shared Song Night, Duri's own work and wish, tram-current geography and the imps' ignored fan warning. Duri remains free until the later off-panel accident and call.

panels.stage: Wide new underwater city from below the same circular castle pool opening: hanok lane left, pearl bridge centre, mint tiled bathhouse on the route lower right and shell concert stage beyond. Bakers pack golden warm snacks and tailors tie bright ribbons as quiet supporting actions. Roshan/Rumi arrive in ordinary costumes, no hat/lens, no surface sky or missing candle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Under the pool lay a whole neighbourhood. Tonight, everyone would sing together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The baker packed warm snacks. The tailor hung bright ribbons. Everyone had a song to bring.

panels.stage: In the hanok lane Duri hands Roshan/Rumi a shell-shaped invitation. His mint floral shell, four flippers, small courier bag and bell are clear; background neighbours continue preparations. Invitation handoff is the focal action, not an object collage.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Song Night! Bring your own voice! One last invitation for the bathhouse. Then I get a turn too!

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: The lanterns go up. The singing begins.

panels.stage: Bubble tram crosses the same pearl bridge above a visible blue current; Roshan watches a loose leaf sweep under it. Connected bridge route and sheltered ledges establish the exact current that returns during the rescue.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Stay beside me under the bridge. The tram stirs a strong current.

panels.stage: At the connected bridge approach the costumed performer and magician slide ONE tall pleated purple-and-gold stage fan onto the shallow shelf under the rail. Its integral weighted base is supported on the shelf while the hinged slatted panel stays tipped upright over the delivery opening. Pleated/folded does not mean flat safe stow. Duri points to that opening; no strap loop or trapped turtle yet.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: Our entrance will be HUGE!

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: That fan is hanging over my delivery path.

panels.stage: Magician dismisses Duri while hurrying stageward with the performer. The same fan remains tipped over the shelf edge, with its loose cloth tie visible. Duri still swims freely and protests; his courier bag strap is separate from the fan tie. Do not depict the later fall, trapped shell or the page-12 fully flat safe stow yet.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: We'll move it later. Come and clap!

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: But I need to get through now.

pages.title: Everybody has an idea
pages.consequence: Friends accidentally overwrite the promised turn; Roshan starts to disappear in their enthusiasm.

panels.stage: Small rehearsal nook overlooking bridge. Rumi introduces tall Hana and younger Nari; Hana stretches large fin, Nari holds little shell drum.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Hana dances. Nari keeps the beat. Tonight, Roshan wants...

panels.stage: Hana sweeps into choreography mid-sentence; Nari taps an energetic beat. Rumi joins in before completing her introduction.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: A giant finish!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: And a booming beginning!

panels.stage: Roshan raises a small hand between their overlapping gestures, looking puzzled rather than ashamed.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I wanted...

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Rumi first, then all of us!

pages.title: The swallowed sentence
pages.consequence: Her silence is a social problem, not proof her voice lacks value; noise masks a real nearby call.

panels.stage: Roshan starts a sentence toward friends rehearsing; she is visible and her hand remains up.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Could I sing the...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: She had practised her three words all morning. She wanted them to be heard.

panels.stage: Nari hits a drum flourish as distant imps test bubbles on stage; Hana responds to the beat. Roshan lowers her hand.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.text: BOOM!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The end of her sentence disappeared.

panels.stage: Roshan turns toward bridge, hearing something separate from the music. A tiny invitation bell drifts from beneath the bridge.

entries.speaker: Duri, off-panel
entries.text: Help!

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: That wasn't part of the song.

pages.title: Wait for me
pages.consequence: Roshan persists with a complete request, and the team changes direction because she speaks.

panels.stage: Trio begin swimming toward stage; Roshan stays at bridge and raises an open stop hand.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Wait! Someone needs help!

panels.stage: Hana turns, uncertain; the tram passes and muffles another call. Nari lowers her drum.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I thought that was an echo.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I heard it twice. Please come and look.

panels.stage: Rumi turns back fully; all three follow Roshan down toward the drifting bell.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: We're coming.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: This time, Roshan finished her sentence.

pages.title: Under the bridge
pages.consequence: The group locates the exact problem. Duri explains what hurts rather than being a passive prize.

panels.stage: Low, clearly connected route under pearl bridge: fallen folded fan lies against rail/shelf with Duri's courier bag strap looped around its base. The lowered edge rests on his shell, not his head/flippers; head exposed, four intact flippers.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Down here!

panels.stage: Roshan and Rumi settle on flat ledge beside Duri, Hana and Nari outside the incoming current.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: The fan slipped. My bag is caught, and I can't back out.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: We'll go one step at a time.

panels.stage: Hana reaches toward the fan's upper edge; Roshan sees the strap tighten around its base.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I can pull it up!

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Wait. That tugs my bag!

pages.title: Stop means stop
pages.consequence: Her boundary immediately stops a harmful first attempt. The story gives listening responsibility to friends.

panels.stage: Hana tries one small upward movement; bag strap visibly taut, Duri worried. Roshan raises hand.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Stop!

panels.stage: Tram current rushes behind. Roshan addresses Hana directly, firm and worried; no injury or violent action.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Hana. Stop pulling. Duri asked us to wait.

panels.stage: Hana releases upward force and braces fan safely in the same resting position. All eyes now on Duri.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I'm stopping. Tell us what you need.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Loosen my bag first. Please.

pages.title: The little loop
pages.consequence: Duri supplies expertise, Roshan turns the plan into a safe action, and Rumi provides independent support.

panels.stage: Duri points with one flipper to strap loop; Roshan follows. Only weighted base rests on flat shelf. Tilted slatted panel still blocks exit, supported by Rumi/Hana, clear of his shell.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Push the fan back a little. That will loosen the loop.

panels.stage: Hana braces top edge; Rumi supports low edge with both hands; Roshan nudges base opposite original upward pull.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: I'll hold this edge. Hana, keep it steady.

panels.stage: Close original drawing of Roshan lifting now-slack strap from base peg with one hand, placing other hand on low fan edge to join support; Duri watches, small relief.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Loose... and off!

pages.title: A stronger rush
pages.consequence: A new current changes the rescue; Roshan asks for help rather than proving she can do everything alone.

panels.stage: Nari feels water change and points upward to bubble tram; loose bell and Roshan's hair drift together. Roshan has now joined low-edge support with both hands.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Another tram! Hold on!

panels.stage: Current swings fan toward its original resting position. Roshan's supporting arm wobbles; Duri remains safe between supported edge and shelf.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: WHOOSH! The fan pushed back.

panels.stage: Roshan makes eye contact with Rumi. Rumi shifts her existing low-edge grip beside Roshan at the strained end; Hana continues supporting hinge, no strap about neck/body.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Rumi, I need help at this end!

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Coming beside you.

pages.title: One move together
pages.consequence: Distinct team roles finish the physical rescue; Duri actively frees himself.

panels.stage: Current settles. Nari gives small clear cue while Hana braces hinge and Roshan/Rumi lift low edge together.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Ready... now!

panels.stage: Duri paddles backward through the opening, four flippers moving, freed bag held close to his shell. Roshan gives specific clear direction.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Back this way, Duri. We've got it.

panels.stage: Duri completely clear; Hana guides folded fan flat onto deeper shelf so it cannot fall again, Rumi retrieves drifting bell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Four flippers wriggled. One turtle was free!

pages.title: Heard at last
pages.consequence: The rescue result persists; Duri names the imp problem and makes his own request.

panels.stage: Duri reunited with bag and bell, all on sheltered flat ledge; bridge path now open, folded fan secured flat.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I told those imps the path was blocked. They just kept talking.

panels.stage: Roshan still trembling lightly; Hana listens with open hands instead of taking charge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: My voice shook when I shouted.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I'm glad you told me to stop. I thought being strong would help. I should have asked first.

panels.stage: Duri points to nearby mint bathhouse on route to stage. Rumi agrees rather than imposing a reward stop.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Can we rest before we go to the show?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Yes. The bathhouse is right here.

pages.title: Warm water, true words
pages.consequence: The rest scene repairs the original relationship. The adults/friends own their listening mistake.

panels.stage: Mint tiled underwater bathhouse, warm vent pools, all four mermaids and Duri resting. Nari folds a cream towel on her head, visible outfits remain modest and recognisable.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: In the warm bathhouse, Roshan found another sentence.

panels.stage: Roshan faces Rumi, serious but safe. Rumi listens, hands still.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I wanted a turn in the song. You all kept talking.

panels.stage: Rumi leans down to Roshan's level; Hana and Nari listen without playing instruments.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: We did. I promised you a turn, then forgot to make room. I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I chose the song before you could choose.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: And my drum was louder than you.

pages.title: Little things count
pages.consequence: An ordinary comfort request changes the scene; her voice matters without a rescue or a performance.

panels.stage: Roshan notices warm vent beside original pool and points to quieter adjoining cooler ledge within the same bathhouse.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can we sit in the cooler pool?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Of course.

panels.stage: Friends move together to the cooler pool. Hana offers a cream towel with open palm, waiting for an answer.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Would you like a towel?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Not on my head, please.

panels.stage: Hana accepts Roshan's choice immediately; Nari puts extra folded towel on her own head, becoming a funny rabbit.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: All right. I'll put it beside you instead.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Then I'll wear enough for two! I am the queen of rabbits!

pages.title: She gets to choose
pages.consequence: Roshan makes an ordinary personal request and receives space before the second heroic act.

panels.stage: Hana folds her large fin aside to make space on bathhouse bench; Nari's towel has deliberately comic bunny ears.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: What would you like your first line to be?

panels.stage: Roshan tries her chosen three words; friends wait quietly, attentive rather than coaching her pitch.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Here I am!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Here you are!

panels.stage: Roshan laughs at Nari's drooping towel ears while Duri rests comfortably beside them.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can we try it again at supper?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: As many times as you like. We'll each have a turn.

pages.title: A feast and a beginning
pages.consequence: The lavish couch scene gives Roshan the promised rehearsal; interruption now steals a real chosen turn.

panels.stage: Original wide couch banquet view: long extravagant coral table fills foreground, rows of gimbap, golden snacks, fruit platters, tiers of pastel sweets and four shell cups; all friends/Duri relax on cream couch. Nari still has bunny-ear towel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Supper filled a table almost as long as the couch.

panels.stage: Duri chooses small fruit plate; Hana settles his cup within reach. Roshan sits forward, asking rather than waiting invisibly.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: A fruit mountain! I'll start at the bottom.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can I start our song now?

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: We're listening.

panels.stage: Roshan begins, small delighted solo; Rumi/Nari/Duri attentive. New view, no crop of prior feast art.

entries.speaker: Roshan, singing
entries.text: Here I...

pages.title: The loud interruption
pages.consequence: The imps repeat the listening mistake deliberately and deny her place, making the next conflict personal.

panels.stage: Costumed performer leaps into bathhouse lounge doorway with glittery entrance banner; magician releases harmless bright bubbles; plates safe, no smashed feast. Original reverse angle from couch to door.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: SHOWTIME!

panels.stage: Roshan faces magician and completes a warning; Duri stands beside her. Distinguish this fresh confrontation from generic reaction.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Your fan trapped Duri. You need to hear him.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: He's right here. Let him tell you.

panels.stage: Magician points grandly toward stage and speaks over Roshan. She and friends stop smiling.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Later, little voice. Tonight, WE sing. You clap!

pages.title: I am speaking
pages.consequence: She sets a clear boundary; her allies repeat her request without replacing her voice.

panels.stage: Stage approach outside lounge. Roshan floats level with imp, still small but fully visible, friends just behind.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I am speaking. Please listen. This is everyone's song. My friends have something to sing. And I do too.

panels.stage: Performer gathers long glitter curtain over stage entrance, acting anxious beneath showy grin.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: If we stop, they might forget us!

panels.stage: Rumi speaks beside Roshan; Hana and towel-free Nari also hold position. They back her rather than dragging her away.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Roshan has a turn too.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: We can all fit in one song.

pages.title: The curtain goes up
pages.consequence: The imps choose escalation; the scene establishes a comprehensible contested stage and safe exits.

panels.stage: Full shell stage and neighbourhood audience well back on terraces. Magician lightly touches one stray bubble with his star wand and it pops; then performer draws glitter curtain across microphone approach. Low foam-star basket and clear open side aisle.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Then watch our BIGGEST trick!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: With a tap of his wand, he popped a stray bubble.

panels.stage: Bubble curtain swells across approach, harmless foam stars start tumbling outward. Duri holds small invitation bell by side aisle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Bubbles bulged. Foam stars flew. Nobody could reach the microphone.

panels.stage: Roshan turns to trio, points to side aisle and asks specific help, not a magical attack.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I need you beside me. Let's keep a way through.

pages.title: The friends make a plan
pages.consequence: Roshan leads with concrete jobs; Rumi safeguards the audience and returns, preserving her own agency.

panels.stage: Rumi swims along terrace edge directing neighbours into open side aisle; one finger points at clearly safe route.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: This way, everyone. I'll keep the aisle open.

panels.stage: Hana takes long spare soft stage cloth from hook while Nari raises small drum; no sword/film costume.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I'll catch the stars.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I'll give us a swimming beat.

panels.stage: Roshan watches gaps between bubbles. Duri hands his last invitation to the bathhouse neighbour in the safe aisle, then takes handrail position with his bell. All positions distinct.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Last delivery! Now I can help.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I'll go through the gaps. Duri, ring if the path closes.

pages.title: A beat to swim by
pages.consequence: The original work-song coordinates distinct moves. Action shifts from holding to evasive swimming.

panels.stage: Nari gives gentle regular drum cue; Rumi returns from safe audience aisle to bubble edge. Trio sing short work-call.

entries.speaker: Trio, singing
entries.text: Hold a beat. Leave a space.

panels.stage: Roshan dives low under first bubble, one continuous tail arcing; a foam star sails high toward Hana.

entries.speaker: Trio, singing
entries.text: Help each friend to find their place.

panels.stage: Hana opens cloth like broad hammock, catches first star; Nari ducks next floating one. Diagonal sequential framing.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Caught it!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: And duck!

pages.title: Change the way
pages.consequence: An imp response forces a changed route; Roshan uses the established current lesson and asks for a pause.

panels.stage: Performer sees Roshan nearly through, swings glitter curtain across her path; magician sends second bubble puff, not injury.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: You're missing our grand finish!

panels.stage: Roshan brakes before curtain. Duri rings invitation bell, Nari immediately stops drum and draws trio attention.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.text: DING!

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Pause! I need a different way.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Give us a turn. We'll watch yours too.

panels.stage: Roshan points to current underneath bubble edge; Rumi follows her eyes rather than grabbing/towing her.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: The current goes under. Rumi, come with me.

pages.title: Under and around
pages.consequence: Roshan and Rumi make a coordinated advance; Hana/Nari keep the contested route clear.

panels.stage: Large diagonal hero panel: Roshan/Rumi sweep under bright bubble curtain together, protected hands/heads/one tail each; current ribbons carry motion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Under the bubbles. Around the curtain. Together!

panels.stage: Hana/Nari fold catch-cloth inward, moving captured foam stars into basket outside aisle, not throwing them at people.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Stars in the basket!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Space on the stage!

panels.stage: Magician steps back to show off, blowing one oversized bubble with wand; performer cheers, unaware curtain tassel is drifting toward wand.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Nobody can miss THIS!

pages.title: The trick goes wrong
pages.consequence: The imps' own escalation creates the climax; objects and help call are set up before rescue.

panels.stage: Glitter curtain tassel catches wand tip, magician fumbles it. Wand clearly slips OUTSIDE new bubble toward Rumi.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The tassel snagged. The wand slipped.

panels.stage: Magician backs INTO giant bubble; translucent sphere closes around his body and nudges him toward broad stage arch. Feet, hands, hat intact, no suffocation or injury.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Oh! This isn't the trick! Where's my wand? I can't reach it!

panels.stage: Inside bubble magician waves and calls. Performer faces audience in big bow, does NOT hear or see trapped friend; Rumi retrieves fallen wand.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Help!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: His friend was still bowing.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: Ta-daaa!

pages.title: Somebody needs help
pages.consequence: Roshan sees and hears her opponent as a person; she states Stop again and the repaired friends immediately heed it.

panels.stage: Roshan sees magician's waving hands behind cloudy bubble. Loud spectacle contrasts his frightened face.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: He's waving. He needs help!

panels.stage: Roshan plants open palm toward everyone. Hana halts cloth, Nari stops beat, performer finally turns.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Stop the show! Listen to him!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: This time, nobody told her to wait.

panels.stage: Magician holds both hands flat against inside of bubble, now clearly audible; Roshan responds at eye level.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: I can't get out.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: We hear you. We're here. We won't leave you.

pages.title: Hold, then pop
pages.consequence: The team slows the bubble and rescues with explicit safe order; the performer must choose to help.

panels.stage: Bubble drifting sideways near wide stage arch; Hana/Nari catch sphere directly in their cloth, supporting it on low platform. Roshan directs performer toward fixed curtain hook outside the aisle.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Catch the bubble in the cloth!

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: What can I do?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Tie back the curtain!

panels.stage: Performer ties curtain back to fixed hook, opening approach. Hana/Nari cradle bubble directly in cloth on low stage platform. Rumi floats level outside with retrieved wand.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Ready below?

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Ready!

panels.stage: Rumi touches bubble with wand; one gentle pop, magician lands a short distance into padded cloth supported by Hana/Nari. Roshan steadies his forearm; no painful fall.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.text: POP!

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: Oof. Thank you.

pages.title: Now they listen
pages.consequence: The imp's change follows lived experience; Roshan need not perform or shout to deserve attention.

panels.stage: Magician seated safely in cloth, hat crooked, small serious face; Roshan beside him, eye contact.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: I called and called. Nobody heard me.

panels.stage: Duri moves beside Roshan. Performer sets entrance banner down and listens.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: That was how I felt under the bridge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: And when you talked over me.

panels.stage: Magician and performer face both Duri and Roshan with open hands, no instant generic smiling.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: I'm sorry. We should have listened.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: I'm sorry I talked over you. I was afraid nobody would clap.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I was afraid too. I still wanted a turn.

pages.title: Room means doing something
pages.consequence: Amends are concrete, persistent and shared; the imps receive a fair turn without erasing Roshan's.

panels.stage: Curtain remains tied to the same hook from rescue. Performer folds the catch-cloth on side platform; magician puts wand/foam basket safely aside, opening microphone approach to neighbours.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: They packed away the trick and opened the stage to everyone.

panels.stage: Magician addresses Duri directly; Duri points toward bridge, confident.

entries.speaker: Magician
entries.text: After the song, we'll collect our fan.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I'll show you the safe way to carry it.

panels.stage: Roshan reaches toward microphone in centre with friends behind; imps deliberately step aside.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I want the first line. Then you can have your turn.

entries.speaker: Performer
entries.text: All right. We're listening.

pages.title: Here I am!
pages.consequence: The opening wish is fulfilled unmistakably by Roshan alone, followed by a real community answer.

panels.stage: Large Roshan solo at shell microphone, mouth beginning three chosen words; smallest protagonist holds centre with one rainbow tail, everyone else waits.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Her voice wobbled a little. She sang anyway.

entries.speaker: Roshan, singing
entries.text: Here I am!

panels.stage: Trio answer from their own stage places, smiling attentively, Duri rings invitation bell.

entries.speaker: Rumi, Hana and Nari, singing
entries.text: Here you are!

panels.stage: Neighbourhood audience from hanok lane, shops and bathhouse terraces answers; original broad community frame, no mirror of previous composition.

entries.speaker: Everyone, singing
entries.text: Near or far, big or small, we make room for us all!

pages.title: A turn is a turn
pages.consequence: Sharing means waiting and responding, not everybody overpowering Roshan's payoff; Duri finishes his work.

panels.stage: Imps perform small comic bow and gentle bubbles off to side during THEIR turn. Roshan applauds with trio, microphone shared deliberately.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The imps had a turn. Then the neighbours did. Nobody had to steal the song.

panels.stage: Duri at microphone during his own turn, empty courier bag beside him, mint floral shell and four flippers visible. Neighbours cheer encouragingly.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: My deliveries are done. My turn to sing!

panels.stage: Roshan and Nari trade little call-and-answer on stage while Hana/Rumi clap beat. One clear mutual choice.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Another line?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Yes. And then one of yours.

pages.title: A place at home
pages.consequence: The ending transfers Roshan's agency to an ordinary candle-search idea. Rumi listens; the unresolved stolen-candle mystery receives no location, clue, reveal or reward.

panels.stage: Roshan and Rumi swim back up through circular pool opening; city below still inside castle, shell song lights fading gently. New upward perspective.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: They swam back up through Rumi's pool. The rainbow was still turning.

panels.stage: Pool-room bench. Rumi listens while Roshan raises a finger to offer an idea about their still-missing candle; no microphone, hero reward, visible candle or genuine new clue. The detective hat and lens remain stored in the same wardrobe if it appears in the background.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: What shall we do tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I have an idea about our candle. Can I tell you?

panels.stage: Rumi sits beside Roshan with attentive eyes. Close on Roshan's hopeful ordinary face; no visual spotlight test, perfect-voice requirement, candle discovery or revealed location. End with the chance to speak, not the recovery of an object.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: I'm listening.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan didn't wait for her voice to be perfect. She began.

source_revision.candle_scope: Established missing castle rainbow candle remains absent and unresolved. The bench glint is proved to be reflected light, not a candle clue or recovery.

detective_prop_reference.reviewed: Viewed at native resolution by /root/story_editor on 2026-10-12.
detective_prop_reference.role: Hat and hand magnifier prop reference ONLY.
detective_prop_reference.permitted_details: Plum/brown deerstalker hat with gold edging and shell medallions; round gold-rimmed hand magnifier with teal handle and gold shell details.
detective_prop_reference.excluded_details: Do not substitute this card's long hair, face, jacket, cape, sleeves, collar, bag, full outfit or body/tail identity. Preserve the current Here I Am cast identity and ordinary coral/cream costume.

story_summary: Roshan wants to sing the first line herself. Before diving beneath Rumi's pool, she puts on her familiar detective hat, asks Rumi to watch a rainbow glint, and tests it with her magnifier and a palm shadow. It is only reflected light; the castle candle remains missing. In the neighbourhood, friends talk over her wish and imps disregard Duri's warning. Roshan speaks firmly, asks for help and joins a careful bridge rescue. Honest bathhouse conversation repairs the forgotten promise; a lavish couch feast gives her another chance to practise. The imps interrupt and block the shared stage, but their oversized bubble traps the magician. Roshan stops the noise, helps the team rescue him and asks for her first line. The imps apologise and make practical amends. Roshan sings, the city answers, and everyone has a turn. At home Rumi listens to her next idea about the still-missing candle.

causality_check.editorial_source_review: The four-page reallocation preserves the established causal adventure. This is a source review, not acceptance of future artwork or an observed child response.
causality_check.voice_wish: All five original page-2 entries are retained verbatim, before any investigation or rescue. Rumi listens to a hypothesis even though it proves incorrect; attention is not a prize for being right or heroic.
causality_check.montage: Retrieve hat, place it, settle brim; retrieve lens, inspect bare-stone glint, ask Rumi to watch, shade then unshade the light path, verify light only and stow both tools before diving. Every panel changes an observable action, state or knowledge.
causality_check.candle: No actual candle silhouette, wax, flame, secret location, Ember token, recovery or new candle prop is pictured or discovered. The local reflection question resolves; the larger candle mystery remains open.
causality_check.route_and_trigger: Five arrival panels establish hanok neighbourhood, invitation and own-turn wish, tram current, unsafe fan and ignored warning. Duri is still free on page 4; his separate call and bell on page 6 cause the bridge rescue.
causality_check.first_setpiece: Pages 8-12 remain exact: taut strap stops first pull; Duri explains; supported base movement loosens loop; Roshan removes it; tram rush prompts help; coordinated opening lets Duri actively back out; fan is stowed only after release.
causality_check.second_setpiece: Pages 20-27 remain exact: shared-stage blockage, work-song swimming, curtain reversal, reroute, dropped wand outside oversized bubble, unheard help, clear Stop, direct cloth catch, fixed-hook curtain repair, wand pop and supported landing.
causality_check.rest_and_feast: Bathhouse truth, specific apologies and ordinary preferences remain before the extravagant couch feast. The interrupted practice therefore harms a repaired promise, not an abstract performance goal.
causality_check.ending: Shared turns and solo payoff remain exact. Page 32 transfers her voice to an ordinary candle idea; it does not reveal the idea, claim a real clue or resolve the theft.
